title.narrative: Updated National Base Curriculum and Digital Transformation Policy from the Prioritized Program for Educational Innovation and Transformation funded by the Global Partnership for Education (GPE).

description.narrative:
Revise the current National Base Curriculum for Primary Education with the purpose of updating the areas of communication and language, mathematics, and science for the entire primary level of the national education system, responding to the demands of the current educational community, and the need to strengthen learner’s skills for the 21st-century.
Support the implementation of the Digital transformation policy that aims to promote the digital transformation of the National Educational System through the equitable and sustainable use of digital technologies, ensuring the provision of adequate digital resources to promote the inclusion, connectivity, and the strengthening of digital skills for students, teachers, and the educational community.
